verdict.rationale: Sentry's own AI agent, Seer, scans incoming issues to find root causes and automate triage. It draws on issue details, traces, logs and profiles, and Seer Agent answers natural-language questions about telemetry. Together these give responders AI-generated incident context, but the evidence never describes an explicit incident or alert summary feature. missing for 10: documented AI-generated issue/incident summaries, AI summaries attached to alert notifications for responders, independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
It uses Sentry's rich context (issue details, tracing data, logs, and profiles) to help you troubleshoot and fix errors and performance issues faster.
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
